message.content: {"caption":"Six-panel benchmark chart comparing VERA with baseline agents across model sizes and task benchmarks.","description":"A six-panel chart. Green denotes VERA and gray denotes comparison models. (a) AutoCoWorkBench plots overall score against model size (4B, 9B, 27B): solid green VERA points are 12.1, 31, and 71.6; dashed gray Base LLM points are 4.1, 16.8, and 55. Lines connect each series from left to right, showing both rising with model size. A dotted horizontal line labeled “Best frontier reference,” with a small AI mark, runs near the top of the plot. A people-at-computers pictogram and the green label “CoWork” identify the benchmark. (b) AutoMedBench uses the same axes and series: VERA scores are 38.6, 69.1, and 80.7; Base LLM scores are 18.4, 52, and 63.9. Both series rise with model size; the dotted best-frontier reference and AI mark are near the top. A medical clipboard-and-pill pictogram and the green label “Med” identify this benchmark. (c) AutoCoWorkBench horizontal bars show overall score, with model labels at left and bars extending right from zero: VERA-CoWork-27B 71.6 (green), GPT-5.6-Sol 70.3, Claude-Opus-4.8 66.6, Qwen3.8-27B 55, GLM-5.2 52.7, GPT-5.6-Terra 52.5, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro 39.2 (gray). (d) AutoMedBench horizontal bars show overall score: VERA-Med-27B 80.7 (green), Claude-Opus-4.8 80.5, GPT-5.6-Sol 75.1, DeepSeek-V4-Pro 72.4, GPT-5.6-Terra 68.3, Qwen3.8-27B 63.9, and GLM-5.2 56.3 (gray). (e) Automation Bench horizontal bars show pass rate: GPT-5.6-Sol 45.8, VERA-CoWork-27B 43.8 (green), Claude-Opus-4.8 41, GPT-5.6-Terra 37.2, DeepSeek-V4-Pro 31.8, GLM-5.2 26.2, and Qwen3.8-27B 24.6 (gray). (f) AgentClinic horizontal bars show accuracy: Claude-Opus-4.8 84.1, GPT-5.6-Sol 80.4, VERA-Med-27B 76.4 (green), GLM-5.2 74.8, GPT-5.6-Terra 72.1, DeepSeek-V4-Pro 58.8, and Qwen3.8-27B 43.9 (gray). All bar values are printed at their bar ends; the horizontal axes start at zero, with tick intervals of 25 in (c) and (d), 15 in (e), and 30 in
